prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, Polynesian goddess physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person; a powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere; thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing; her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame; solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long wavy lavender hair — wearing a minimal two-piece of a tiny bra top of two small cups on thin strings and a micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, both made of densely patterned black floral lace with the flowers closely overlapping and only a fine sheer net showing between them, the material evenly tinted and softly diffusing so her own skin tone glows through it as a gentle blur, the rest of her body bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin across her whole body, including where the sheer material veils it, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, slightly darker skin over her elbows and a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms. The tiny garments show real material behaviour: dense lace flowers packed close across the small cups and the tiny triangle, scalloped edges lying flat, the thin strings pressing lightly into her skin. Pose: hands on her hips in a powerful stance, chin lifted, weight on one leg — most extreme Polynesian goddess silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy black lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge.

Background: a sunlit red-rock canyon floor with a smooth sandy path, low boulders of knee height and a waist-high wooden trail rail, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
